faqSection.subtitle: Quick answers about Five Cut Pro and KOC video templates.

items.question: I have never shot video before, can I use this?
items.answer: Absolutely! Don't know how to shoot? We guide you how to shoot! Every KOC template includes sample clips showing each camera angle and action. Just watch the sample and record.

items.question: I don't know how to edit, how does the app help?
items.answer: Five Cut Pro edits for you 100%! You don't need any CapCut or editing skills. Simply attach your recorded shots to the template, and the app cuts, paces, and merges the final video right on your device.

items.question: How can a few source videos produce hundreds of non-duplicate clips?
items.answer: Five Cut Pro uses an intelligent combinatorial engine. From 3-5 raw source angles, it crafts hundreds of unique structural variations, protecting your account from TikTok duplicate content flags.

items.question: Is the template content easy to understand?
items.answer: Very simple and easy! You don't need to do anything complex, just follow our guide. Every template is distilled from top-converting KOC short-form sales videos.

items.question: Is the app free and which platforms are supported?
items.answer: Five Cut Pro is officially available on iOS (App Store) for iPhone and iPad. The Android version is currently in final testing and coming soon to Google Play.

brandsPage.whyTitle: Three reasons brands pick Five Cut Pro

why.title: Content at scale
why.desc: One product becomes several templates, several creators and many selling videos. Promotion turns into a repeatable system instead of one-off deals.

why.title: Right place, right moment
why.desc: Your brand shows up when creators are most focused: while they learn how to film and build the video for the product.

why.title: One consistent message
why.desc: Many creators share the same shot recipe, so structure and message stay aligned instead of drifting per creator.

faq.question: What do we need to provide?
faq.answer: Product photos, packaging, logo, brand colours and product information. Five Cut Pro turns that into a video template plus shot-guide videos in a five-angle sequence: wide, medium, product close-up, detail, and in-use.

faq.question: How is the cost calculated?
faq.answer: By the scope you pick: brand visibility, creator matching, custom templates, or the full package. Leave your details in the form and the team will propose a fit for your campaign size. Brands joining during the early phase get the first three months free.

faq.question: How long until the template is live?
faq.answer: Once the product and message are agreed, Five Cut Pro films the product, builds the template and the shot guides, then publishes them to the template market. Timing depends on how many templates and how complex the product is — the team confirms a schedule during the call.

faq.question: How is performance measured?
faq.answer: Reporting follows the scope you chose: impressions on the brand placements, how many creators received and joined the campaign, and how many videos were made from your templates.

faq.question: How are creators selected?
faq.answer: TikTok sign-in lets Five Cut Pro see which product categories a creator actually works in, so campaigns go to a relevant group instead of a mass blast.

comparePage.metaTitle: Five Cut Pro vs CapCut — what is actually different?
comparePage.metaDescription: A straight comparison: CapCut is a freeform editor, Five Cut Pro is a template workflow for selling videos. Which one fits which job.
comparePage.heroTitle: Five Cut Pro vs CapCut — what is actually different?
comparePage.heroSubtitle: Two apps solving two different problems. Here is which one fits which job — including when the answer is CapCut.

rows.ours: Publishing selling videos consistently from templates
rows.other: Editing a video freely, however you want

rows.ours: A template that already carries a shot guide
rows.other: An empty timeline or a generic template

rows.ours: Sample clip and description for every angle in the template
rows.other: None; you decide the shots yourself

rows.ours: The app counts attached segments and warns when a source is shorter than the recipe
rows.other: You find out while editing, often rebuilding the cut

rows.ours: Drop new clips into the saved recipe
rows.other: Reopen the project and rework each segment
Very high: effects, text, keyframes, voiceover

rows.ours: A checklist tells you what to film
rows.other: You learn editing and shot selection on your own

rows.ours: Yes — in the app and the community groups

whenOurs.title: Pick Five Cut Pro when
points: You must publish selling videos regularly and editing is the bottleneck
You are unsure which angles a product needs
You want to reuse a recipe that already performed on another product
You want brand campaigns to reach you inside the app

whenOther.title: Pick CapCut when
points: You need effects, animated text, keyframes or detailed voiceover
Every video is its own idea rather than a repeated structure
You already edit timelines and want frame-level control

comparePage.honestNote: The two are not mutually exclusive. Plenty of creators use Five Cut Pro for steady output from a recipe, then open CapCut for the occasional special video.

faq.question: Can Five Cut Pro replace CapCut?
faq.answer: No, and it does not try to. Five Cut Pro solves output volume for template-based selling videos. When you need freeform editing with effects and keyframes, CapCut is still the better tool.

faq.question: Can I keep editing a Five Cut Pro export in CapCut?
faq.answer: Yes. Merged videos sit under Exported videos on your phone; save to the gallery and open them in any editor.

faq.question: Does merging need an internet connection?
faq.answer: Merging runs on the device. You need a connection to load templates from the market and to share to TikTok.

faq.question: Never edited a video before — where should I start?
faq.answer: Start with Five Cut Pro: each template has a sample clip and a description per angle, so you know what to film before you hit record.
